current_flow: G3-04 produces an immutable FramePlan containing FrameState and a complete ReferenceDrawList, then submits the plan through the renderer-neutral IRenderBackend const-reference seam.
target_owner: Render Core privately owns Skia rasterization. The public backend header owns only renderer-neutral configuration, observation, typed issue, and submission behavior.
target_flow: SkiaHeadlessBackend validates the complete immutable FramePlan, rasterizes all nine typed ReferenceCommand variants into a fixed offscreen surface, reads RGBA bytes, computes a corroborative digest, and atomically replaces the prior observation only after successful readback.
prepare_commit_publication_abort: Validation and surface/readback are private preparation. Successful readback replaces the optional observation once. Every rejection returns before observation replacement and preserves the prior successful observation; there is no canonical-state or presentation publication.

nine_kind_mapping.Shape: solid transformed visualBounds plus post-draw FilledPath clear mask
nine_kind_mapping.VectorPath: filled canonical path honoring fill rule
nine_kind_mapping.RichText: one deterministic placeholder cell per validated Unicode scalar
nine_kind_mapping.VectorStroke: axis-aligned sample segments with butt caps
nine_kind_mapping.Connector: straight segment or deterministic horizontal-then-vertical orthogonal elbow
nine_kind_mapping.Group: ordered traversal entry with zero pixel contribution

obligation_to_verification.G3-05-V1-private-skia-boundary: public-header scan, const FramePlan submission, private CanvasSkia linkage, and runtime boundary check
obligation_to_verification.G3-05-V2-deterministic-raster: independent 262144-byte RGBA corpus, independent FNV-1a digest, exact replay equality, transform/clip/erase assertions
obligation_to_verification.G3-05-V3-reference-command-coverage: distinguishable nine-kind fixture, per-region pixel assertions, traversal order, Group/no-Group pixel equality, and orthogonal connector oracle
obligation_to_verification.G3-05-V4-rejection-isolation: typed invalid-config, overflow, identity, empty-plan, unsupported-geometry, attached-endpoint, and erase-mask rejections with unchanged input/observation
obligation_to_verification.G3-05-V5-boundary-hygiene: authorized changed-path inventory, no public Skia/platform types, G3 predecessor matrix, RF01/G2 matrix, runtime boundary check, and git diff --check

test_plan: Preserve the observed missing-backend RED before production implementation.
Require exact independent RGBA and digest equality for the frozen nine-kind fixture.
Exercise transform order, viewport clipping, erase, straight and orthogonal connector routing, replay, and Group zero-pixel behavior.

Run the G3 predecessor matrix, RF01/G2 matrix, dependency/boundary scans, SDK resolution, and source hygiene checks.
